title: SolidWorks
description: Drive a local SolidWorks desktop: 66 CAD tools for parts, assemblies, drawings, DFM checks, and FEA. Read-only by default; saves and exports require an explicit one-shot approval.

entry.summary: SolidWorks tools run against your own desktop session. Start with solidworks_status, then solidworks_connect; read-only inspection is safe, modelling needs policy mode "standard", and saving/exporting needs mode "full" plus a solidworks_confirm grant.
entry.setup: Requires Windows, a licensed SolidWorks 2023-2026 desktop, and a Python 3.10+ interpreter with the mcp package. Run `node bin/dsh-solidworks.js doctor` to check all three.
